title: Lace Ruffle Sleeve A-Line Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This lace midi dress combines delicate sequins with elegant paneled detailing for a refined, polished look. The V-neckline frames the upper body beautifully, while the short sleeves add light coverage and a graceful finish. A lovely choice for wedding guest dressing, cocktail parties, holiday events, and other special evening occasions.


Tips: Prioritize the bust measurement when selecting, the fabric is highly elastic and can stretch by at least 2 inches. Consider the waist measurement next, and disregard the hip measurement.

 

Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises lace.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
